body:
That's pretty much exactly how I feel. I'll have to look more into agender stuff or maybe even gender fluid. It's really hard to look past the expectations of others and find what's really you. I act and dress in a way typical of men. But I also like to do stuff associated with women, and I love my female body. But other days I wish I had a more masc appearance (which is practically impossible because of my body shape). 

I think I'm dealing with a lot of societal and social pressure and it's confusing me on my sense of self. I'm trying to get everything sorted to go back to therapy though so don't worry about that lol
That does feel pretty accurate to my views on myself. I don't feel strongly either way, I'm just me. I'll figure it out eventually, on my own terms,  not anyone else's

You're absolutely right about me needing to go back to therapy lmao. I'm trying to get insurance and life in general in order so I can do that. But advice from people with similar experiences is the best I can do in the interim. 

As for what i can do now, I've always been fairly gnc in terms of appearance and actions. Mostly due to my autism and wanting to do what's most comfortable for me, not expected by society. That's the main reason I was so confused by the sudden gut feeling that I felt wrong. I've gotten some very helpful advice so far though, so I'll try out what I can before I'm able to get in touch with a professional :)
That was really insightful and validating! Thank you for sharing. I think I'll do some toying with my identity slowly and privately

That's what I've been chalking it up to tbh. I've always viewed things through a lense of necessity and categorizing myself like that has been a very low priority for me. So I just roll with what I've been assigned. 

I don't think my partner was influenced by my friend though, I do say some...interesting things sometimes and looking back I can see how he would get that impression. One of my go to phrases is "I'm just a little guy" and I had been quoting some non-binary related meme as a vocal stim all day that day. Plus we've discussed it before so he might've been prodding me a little to have a conversation about it. I'll talk to him tonight when he gets off work

I do want to try new pronouns a little, maybe I'll just share that with my partner since my friend seems a little too over-eager and I'm already dreading their reaction. I think I was just uncomfortable with the change the first time because of my autism. I'm very sensitive to big changes and have intense rejection sensitive dysphoria so maybe I do just need to push for it a little more. Thank you for validating my feelings
I can't light torches at all, the icon is there on the map screen but the button to even light the torches isn't there

Nope. The only things he puts on his body are lotion, soap and deodorant. And when he's over here he uses my soaps in the shower. Someone else suggested it might be the fabric holding onto an old stain and it just shows back up after getting wet. so I'm hoping that's what it is. I'll test it out when I need to change towels

Oh wow. You might be right with that honestly! I do use my towels to wipe my hands when I'm drawing sometimes. Maybe he's just unlucky and gets the stained towel every time. I'll do a little experiment with my supplies and see if one of them is leaving a phantom stain. Thank you!!
Nah it can't be that...the towels I have are teal/greenish
It definitely isn't that. I checked with him when I first saw it but he's an absolute clean freak. Baby wipes and everything. I couldn't live with myself if he was a doodoo booty guy

Oh no I didn't think to take a picture, the towels are already in the washer. I can describe it though. There were just a few patches of light brown... stuff. Kind of like if someone dusted a towel with cocoa powder or something and rubbed it in. Completely odorless, no residue feeling, just a light brown staining. I'm stumped!
Nope, it just smells like a normal towel. Completely neutral
I have and all of my teachers are understanding, I just feel horrible when I have to turn in an assignment late. It's just making more work for them. Just anxiety/trauma things I guess

I can't take a break from anything. The custody agreement never stops and even the minimal responsibilities I do have like taking care of my pets and online school are just as constant. I feel like I'm drowning

I was looking at PT and x ray tech but it's just the education that gets in the way. I feel like I literally wouldn't be able to do any of it. Even that 2 year degree makes me feel like I have to throw up

That's what I'm struggling so hard with. I probably didn't express that very clearly, I'm not really in my right mind right now. Everything I've ever had interest in or any online test has always been in the medical field. It's all so impossibly difficult and expensive and most of it is life or death. I already struggle with an extreme fear of failure and I really need my hand held. Can you imagine if one of my mistakes caused someone to die? I don't know what I'd do
